_comment: Store-page metadata kept in version control. As of 2026-09-14 these fields are set
through Apify Console or PUT /v2/acts/{actorId} (which accepts seoTitle, seoDescription,
title, categories and isPublic) — actor.json has no field for them, so without this file
they would live only in the Console UI with no history and no review.
test/definition.test.ts enforces the length limits and keeps the title congruent with
actor.json, the input schema and the README.
seoTitle: App Store & Google Play Review Monitor - New Reviews Only
seoDescription: Track new Google Play and App Store reviews on a schedule. Only reviews since the last run, with rating filters and webhook alerts.
